relationship_policy: Stable local IDs. Every service/person/location/FAQ/contact has an explicit company_id. Company parent_id links only to the group. No person, contact or office assignment is inherited from a parent, name match or photograph.
people_policy: Informational source-listed people only, not registered Legal platform lawyers or users. No account, booking, chat, case, review, availability or payment mapping.
media_policy: Source-attributed photographs with verified card association. Reuse rights are UNVERIFIED and visibly disclosed; restricted or ambiguous photographs are not displayed.
update_policy: Versioned app assets, not live data. New reviews ship in a new app release. No runtime API, database, Storage or website scraping.
